headline: Nominated Quentin Donohue as the 7th member and received the 7/15/2026 meeting minutes.
summary: Members discussed a report on retirees on active plans, including those who must enroll in Medicare. Dazhana Arugeta explained that retirees receive notices to enroll in Medicare Part B three months before turning 65. Anthony Soto raised concerns about other boards paying part of retiree benefits, and the minutes say no funds are received directly for insurance from other boards.
decisions: Approved receiving the 7/15/2026 meeting minutes unanimously.
Approved the nomination of Quentin Donohue as the 7th member unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: Chris Butler made a motion to receive the 7/15/2026 meeting minutes. Anthony Soto seconded. Motion carried unanimously.
MOTION: Chris Butler made a motion to nominate Quentin Donohue as the 7th member. No discussion. Motion carried unanimously.

decision_titles: Nomination of Quentin Donohue as 7th member
